input.quote: a. Grant. TrueLink hereby grants to Client a non-exclusive license to use the Interface in the ordinary course of its business of the origination, underwriting, processing and funding of consumer finance receivables in accordance with this Agreement.
input.rationale: The § 2(a) grant runs to Client alone: affiliates and contractors are not named and there is no notice mechanic to add them, so the fallback element "affiliates covered on written notice" fails. The transfer element also fails: § 15 requires the other party's prior written approval for any assignment, with a carve-out only for "an assignment to a financially responsible affiliate" — no path for a successor in a merger or acquisition. The licence is not revocable at Vendor's discretion (§ 2(c) ties it to termination of the Agreement), so this is a fallback failure rather than walk-away. We therefore target the fallback: affiliates added to the grant on written notice, and a successor-in-M&A carve-out added to the consent requirement. Preferred sub-elements (contractor use, perpetual/irrevocable paid-up licence, termination only for uncured material breach) are noted but not pressed given the hosted subscription structure.

mappings.element: Customer's affiliates are covered on written notice.
The licence is transferable to a successor in a merger or acquisition transaction.

proposal.summary: Extend licence to Client affiliates on written notice and permit transfer to a successor in an M&A transaction.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We need the licence to reach our affiliates on written notice and to travel to a successor in a merger or acquisition, so we have added affiliates to the grant and carved successor transfers out of the consent requirement. This is our fallback position on licence scope.

ops.oldText: TrueLink hereby grants to Client a non-exclusive license to use the Interface in the ordinary course of its business
ops.newText: TrueLink hereby grants to Client, and to its affiliates upon written notice to TrueLink, a non-exclusive license to use the Interface in the ordinary course of its business

ops.oldText: Neither party shall assign or transfer any of its rights under this Agreement without the prior written approval of the other party, except no such approval shall be required for an assignment to a financially responsible affiliate.
ops.newText: Neither party shall assign or transfer any of its rights under this Agreement without the prior written approval of the other party, except no such approval shall be required for an assignment to a financially responsible affiliate or to a successor in a merger or acquisition transaction.
